submitter: bugs_open/357 lane, phase 3 by OWNER DECISION 'Option B' (2026-09-02). Single coherent task: migration 701 — repair the 22 mislabelled tool rows by per-tool adoption (template = stored bytes) with the plan repointed in the same transaction.
rationale: 357's population: 22 live page_components rows each storing a whole working interactive tool under the SHARED hero component's identity — regeneration is the disaster arm (a 2KB hero band minted over a 16KB tool). The previously designed repair (578, retype onto the shared adopted-fragment) left rebuild-safety resting on the armed Layer 2 identity-carry, which is exactly what its own precondition 4 required proving and which this lane showed can only ever be tested VACUOUSLY in place (HANDOFF_2026-08-26b Findings 1-2: the canary chain skips end to end and the conservation loop never runs). The owner ruled Option B: the lendzy-693 shape transferred — each row gets its own content_components row whose html_template IS the stored rendered_html byte for byte (created_from='adopted', component_level='tool', CLC-020 naming), and because these pages' plans are POPULATED (lendzy's were empty), the plan is repointed in the SAME transaction at both levels: site_plan_sections.component_name (durability - pages.sections is a derived copy that sync_pages overwrites from the plan, reconcile_site_plan_action.go:596-599) and the pages.sections element (immediate effect). Post-701 a rebuild renders the adopted template - byte-identical - so the regeneration hazard is closed BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by an untested guard; this is the estate's own fix-ranking rule (make the bad state unrepresentable). Pre-design measurements, all 2026-09-02: the drift reconciler compares pages.built_from_plan_version (a site_plans.id) to the current plan id, and 701 creates no plan row and never touches built_from_plan_version - no drift storm; all 22 stored bodies carry ZERO '{{' (adoption is lossless population-wide, guarded again at apply); all 22 bodies PASS toolTemplateValid through the real production function (in-package probe, must-fail AND must-pass controls both proven, probe deleted); exactly ONE library function collision (tool-equity-release, active manual row a5236dec) - that one adopted component is born a FORK per RFC_036 section 9.3 (verified verbatim: forked_from = the claiming row's id), the other 21 insert with forked_from NULL; section resolution at rebuild tries the STORED component_id first, so repointed rows resolve directly. Selection is by PINNED CENSUS (22 pc_ids + md5s), never by predicate - the licensing measurements were taken against these exact bodies, so the population predicate is re-run at apply time as an exact-set GUARD that aborts on growth (a growth also means the phase 2 birth-fix regressed) or any per-row drift. Scoped apply: -v scope=pilot (DEFAULT, mortgagecalculator/tool-simple alone) then scope=remainder (refuses unless the pilot is verified repaired), per the staged plan; by hand, never the runner (_HOLD). Rollback restores all three legs from a backup table holding full pre-state jsonb, is all-or-nothing with per-row state classification, and carries the inverted deployed_at warning (a rebuild that already deployed from the new identity makes blind rollback WORSE - it re-arms 357's disaster arm).
